game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay, a hidden smugglers' bay: the dock cartographer must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay: a hidden smugglers' bay
core_gameplay_loop: In Smugglers' Bay, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round, a new cannonballs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of cannonballs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Smugglers' Bay'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
